title: Gedolei Roshei Yeshiva Call
body: Leading Israeli gedolim and roshei yeshiva urge yungeleit and bochurim to boost limud haTorah during Chanukah, citing a year when many seek to disrupt Bnei Torah.

title: Israeli Killed in Sydney Attack
body: One Israeli killed, another wounded in Sydney shooting attack on Chanukah celebration; embassy and Foreign Ministry supporting the wounded man's family.
